comments.body: 2026-10-24: on main in 3b6c5316. Ghostty's ctrl+/ case ported beside ctrl+return; a program in legacy mode reads 0x1f. Checked by test only: whether macOS beeps on ctrl+/ in a real key window is Ghostty's account.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Ghostty's view turns C-/ into C-_ in performKeyEquivalent, because macOS beeps on C-/ and never delivers it. Muster's SurfaceView ports only Ghostty's ctrl+return case (73a1352b), so C-/ likely beeps in a Muster pane. Nobody has reported it; noticed while porting ctrl+return on 2026-10-21. Check by hand in a pane (cat -v, then C-/), and port the case if it beeps.
title: Ctrl+/ beeps rather than reaching the pane, where Ghostty turns it into Ctrl+_
